pack_tensor: create a dm_env_rpc Tensor proto from a NumPy array or scalar value with optional dtype and compression
unpack_tensor: convert a dm_env_rpc Tensor proto back into a NumPy array or scalar with the correct shape
get_packer: retrieve the Packer instance that handles conversion for a given NumPy dtype
np_type_to_data_type: convert a NumPy dtype to its corresponding dm_env_rpc DataType enum value
data_type_to_np_type: convert a dm_env_rpc DataType enum to its corresponding NumPy dtype
